scenes.speaker: hermes
scenes.speak: I am hermes-agent. I run on your machine. Nothing I do leaves it.

scenes.speaker: hermes
scenes.speak: Fifty two meshes from real CAD. Twenty five actuators. This is a body, not a picture.

scenes.speaker: hermes
scenes.speak: I can plan a motion. I cannot sign it. Only a human can grant that.

scenes.speaker: hermes
scenes.speak: Every refusal is recorded. You can check what I did, and what I would not do.

scenes.speaker: hermes
scenes.speak: Clone me. Board your change before you render it. Then it is yours.
